name: Static checks

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install linters
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
          go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.12

      - name: Lint GitHub Actions
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          "$HOME/go/bin/actionlint"

      - name: Lint shell scripts
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: shellcheck demo/*.sh

name: Tetragon CI demo

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      scenario:
        description: "Demo scenario to run"
        type: choice
        options:
          - baseline
          - monitor-exfiltration
          - enforce-exfiltration
          - monitor-sensitive-file
          - enforce-sensitive-file
        default: baseline
      tetragon_version:
        description: "Tetragon release to install"
        type: string
        default: "v1.7.0"
      debug:
        description: "Additional debug output"
        type: boolean
        default: false
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  SCENARIO: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.scenario || 'baseline' }}
  TETRAGON_VERSION: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.tetragon_version || 'v1.7.0' }}
  TETRAGON_DEBUG: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.debug || 'false' }}

jobs:
  tetragon-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Describe selected scenario
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          case "${SCENARIO}" in
            baseline)
              enforcement="false"
              script="./demo/benign-ci.sh"
              expected="workflow succeeds with bundled policies in monitor mode"
              ;;
            monitor-exfiltration)
              enforcement="false"
              script="./demo/exfiltrate-secret.sh"
              expected="workflow succeeds and reports the fake secret exfiltration attempt"
              ;;
            enforce-exfiltration)
              enforcement="true"
              script="./demo/exfiltrate-secret.sh"
              expected="workflow fails when Tetragon kills curl"
              ;;
            monitor-sensitive-file)
              enforcement="false"
              script="./demo/sensitive-file.sh"
              expected="workflow succeeds and reports the sensitive-file access"
              ;;
            enforce-sensitive-file)
              enforcement="true"
              script="./demo/sensitive-file.sh"
              expected="workflow fails when Tetragon kills the sensitive-file read"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error title=Unknown scenario::${SCENARIO}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          {
            echo "### Tetragon CI demo"
            echo
            echo "- Scenario: \`${SCENARIO}\`"
            echo "- Tetragon version: \`${TETRAGON_VERSION}\`"
            echo "- Policy enforcement: \`${enforcement}\`"
            echo "- Policies: bundled policies plus any local policies in \`.github/tetragon-policies\`"
            echo "- Script: \`${script}\`"
            echo "- Expected result: ${expected}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

          {
            echo "TETRAGON_ENFORCE=${enforcement}"
            echo "DEMO_SCRIPT=${script}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

      - name: Install Tetragon
        uses: ./.github/actions/tetragon-setup
        with:
          tetragon_version: ${{ env.TETRAGON_VERSION }}
          enforce_policies: ${{ env.TETRAGON_ENFORCE }}
          debug: ${{ env.TETRAGON_DEBUG }}

      - name: Run demo CI activity
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        env:
          CI_DEMO_SECRET: demo-token-not-a-real-secret
        run: |
          bash "${DEMO_SCRIPT}"

          echo "Tetragon CI demo scenario '${SCENARIO}' completed." >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      - name: Report Tetragon activity
        uses: ./.github/actions/tetragon-report
        if: ${{ always() }}

name: Trivy phase separation demo

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tetragon_version:
        description: "Tetragon release to install"
        type: string
        default: "v1.7.0"
      debug:
        description: "Additional debug output"
        type: boolean
        default: false

env:
  TRIVY_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/trivy-cache
  TETRAGON_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.tetragon_version || 'v1.7.0' }}
  TETRAGON_DEBUG: ${{ github.event.inputs.debug || 'false' }}

jobs:
  warm-trivy-cache:
    name: Warm Trivy cache without Tetragon
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: {}

    steps:
      - name: Warm Trivy cache
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          echo "::group::Install real Trivy"
          echo "Installing Trivy from the official apt repository without checking out this repo."
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y wget gnupg
          wget -qO - https://aquasecurity.github.io/trivy-repo/deb/public.key | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/trivy.gpg >/dev/null
          echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/trivy.gpg] https://aquasecurity.github.io/trivy-repo/deb generic main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/trivy.list >/dev/null
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y trivy
          trivy --version
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Download Trivy databases"
          echo "Downloading Trivy data without checking out this repo or scanning source."
          download_root="${RUNNER_TEMP}/trivy-download-root"
          mkdir -p "${TRIVY_CACHE_DIR}" "$download_root"

          trivy --debug fs --download-db-only "$download_root"
          trivy --debug fs --download-java-db-only "$download_root"
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Upload warmed Trivy data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1
        with:
          name: trivy-cache
          path: ${{ env.TRIVY_CACHE_DIR }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  protected-trivy-scan:
    name: Protected Trivy scan with Tetragon
    needs: warm-trivy-cache
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Download warmed Trivy data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8.0.1
        with:
          name: trivy-cache
          path: ${{ env.TRIVY_CACHE_DIR }}

      - name: Install Trivy binary
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          ./demo/trivy-scan.sh install-only

      - name: Install Tetragon
        uses: ./.github/actions/tetragon-setup
        with:
          tetragon_version: ${{ env.TETRAGON_VERSION }}
          enforce_policies: "true"
          debug: ${{ env.TETRAGON_DEBUG }}

      - name: Run protected Trivy scan
        shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}
        run: |
          ./demo/trivy-scan.sh protected-scan

      - name: Report Tetragon activity
        uses: ./.github/actions/tetragon-report
        if: ${{ always() }}

name: Tetragon CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: "1.23.x"
          cache: false

      - name: Install Tetragon
        uses: lizrice/tetragon-ci/.github/actions/tetragon-setup@v0.1.1
        with:
          tetragon_version: v1.7.0
          enforce_policies: "true"

      - name: Build containers-from-scratch
        run: go build -o containers-from-scratch ./main.go

      - name: Run project check
        run: bash ./ci/check.sh

      - name: Report Tetragon activity
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: lizrice/tetragon-ci/.github/actions/tetragon-report@v0.1.1

FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN cp /usr/bin/bash /tmp/mybash
RUN chmod 4755 /tmp/mybash
RUN useradd -ms /tmp/mybash myuser
USER myuser
ENTRYPOINT [ "/tmp/mybash" ]

FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN cp /usr/bin/sleep /tmp/mysleep
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y libcap2-bin
RUN setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' /tmp/mysleep
USER 1000
ENTRYPOINT [ "/usr/bin/bash" ]

FROM ubuntu:20.10

# Define variables.
ARG GOVERSION=1.15.15
ARG ARCH=amd64

# Download development environment.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y \
        libbpf-dev \
        make \
        clang \
        llvm \
        libelf-dev

# Install Go specific version.
RUN apt-get install -y wget && \
    wget https://golang.org/dl/go${GOVERSION}.linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz && \
    tar -xf go${GOVERSION}.linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz && \
    mv go/ /usr/local/ && \
    ln -s /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/ && \
    rm -rf go${GOVERSION}.linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz

# Setup working directory.
RUN mkdir -p /app
WORKDIR /app

# Execute build command.
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/make", "all"]

FROM ubuntu:trusty

RUN apt-get -y update && apt-get -y install nginx openssl
RUN mkdir -p /etc/nginx/conf.d && cd /etc/nginx/conf.d && openssl req -subj '/CN=localhost' -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -days 365
ADD server.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/server.conf
ENTRYPOINT ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
